name: /claude-api
description: Load Claude API and Managed Agents reference material for the project language, with optional migration, upgrade, onboarding, prompt-audit, or cost-optimization workflows.

examples.explanation: Review the documented SDK upgrade workflow before changing an Anthropic API dependency.

conditions: Some subcommands require the corresponding Claude Code version and provider access.

name: /color
description: Set the prompt bar color for the current session or reset it to the default.

examples.explanation: Use a cyan prompt bar to distinguish this session visually.

conditions: Requires Claude Code v2.1.205 or later.

name: /dataviz
description: Load the bundled data-visualization guidance for designing charts, graphs, and dashboards with accessibility and contrast checks.

examples.explanation: Ask the bundled skill for a chart design grounded in the current project data.

conditions: Requires Claude Code v2.1.198 or later.

name: /design-sync
description: Convert a repository’s React design system into a Claude Design system and upload it for reuse in generated designs.

examples.explanation: Name the design system while starting the first-time synchronization flow.

conditions: Requires Claude Design access and a first-party claude.ai connection; unavailable on several third-party providers.
